title: CBC - Fibre Network for Manor Royal Business District  - AWARD
description:
Located to the South-East of London, halfway between the capital and Brighton and adjacent to Gatwick airport, Crawley is home to more than 118 000 residents . The town was disproportionately impacted by the Covid-19 pandemic due to its close associations with the aviation industry, both as a direct employer and through the local supply chain. 
      
      Improving broadband connectivity across the region has been identified as a key driver of economic growth and prosperity. As part of its economic recovery, Crawley Borough Council (CBC) has secured funding via the UK Government's Towns Fund initiative, with up to GBP1.5 million of this funding allocated for capital 'digital' projects. Any digital investment should focus on enabling economic improvements and encourage further investment in the Manor Royal business park and surrounding business districts. 
      
      The proposed project by Crawley Borough Council supports the above objectives, facilitating improved connectivity via the provision of gigabit-capable networks across the region. The wider economic benefits resulting from this, including the security of sufficient infrastructure capacity in the long term, could in turn drive further investment in Manor Royal and surrounding areas, contributing towards Crawley's economic recovery.

title: 613295-M23 Crawley IC South Deck Refurb pavement works
description:
To undertake all PDF works and provide the planning out and resurfacing of the bridge deck contained within the bill of quantities as per Specification and Design Drawings. in liaison with other parties engaged on this scheme to include but not limited to:

-	Carry out resurfacing as per attached specification and design drawings.
-	Produce and maintain a Construction Programme liaising with all other lot providers.
-	Works to be undertaken during full weekend closures (Friday 20:00 - Monday 06:00)
-	Weekly liaison with National Highways (NH) Construction Assurance Manager for programme and roadspace requirements
-	Produce Construction Phase Plan (CPP), (incorporating residual site specific significant hazards from PCI) for Client review, comment and acceptance using National Highways CPP checklist.
-	Provision and maintenance of site office and welfare facilities for all parties associated with the works
-	Liaise with Client to discuss any localised vegetation clearance required prior to installing site office and welfare facilities, 
-	Attend a pre-start meeting prior to commencement of works - to be organised by Client.
-	Should works be notifiable to HSE, advise Client to submit F10.  
-	Organise and chair monthly progress / commercial meeting for scheme duration and close down meeting on completion.
-	Produce monthly spend profile, forward forecasts and calculations for any financial accruals.
-	Liaise with appointed TTM contractor to ensure suitable development of a safe system of work allowing safe access to the structure.
-	Liaise with appointed Designer for technical queries 
-	Liaise with CDM-PD and provide information for H&S File as the scheme progresses and on completion.
-	Provide a Scheme Completion Certificate - template to be provided by Client.
-	Submit an Outputs Certificate on delivery of scheme regional promises - template to be provided by Client
-	Issue a Certificate of Construction Compliance (in accordance with CG300) to the Client on completion of works.
